# Domestika

> Domestika is the largest online creative community offering courses in design, illustration, arts, and crafts taught by industry professionals.

Domestika provides accessible, beginner-friendly online courses for creative professionals across multiple disciplines including graphic design, digital illustration, traditional arts, and DIY crafts. The platform features a community-driven learning experience with certificates, specialization programs, and a premium subscription service.

## Key Topics

- Online Courses
- Graphic Design
- Digital Illustration
- Creative Skills

## Core Learning Platform

- [Online courses for creative professionals | Domestika](https://www.domestika.org/en): Domestika homepage - largest creative community for online learning
- [Online Courses | Domestika](https://www.domestika.org/en/courses): Main course catalog featuring design, marketing, and creative courses
- [Online courses by area](https://www.domestika.org/en/courses/area): Course directory organized by creative skill categories and subjects
- [New Courses | 2026 | Domestika](https://www.domestika.org/en/courses/recent): New courses featuring AI design tools and creative specializations
- [Certificates in all courses | Domestika](https://www.domestika.org/en/certificates): Personalized course completion certificates signed by instructors

## Design & Graphic Design Courses

- [Graphic Design Courses - Visual Communication | 2025 | Domestika](https://www.domestika.org/en/courses/area/34-graphic-design): Graphic design courses covering Canva, Adobe, Figma, visual design
- [Design Courses - Master Creative Skills | 2025 | Domestika](https://www.domestika.org/en/courses/area/1-design): Design courses covering Adobe, Figma, vector graphics, digital design
- [Textile Design Courses - Create Patterns | 2025 | Domestika](https://www.domestika.org/en/courses/area/243-textile-design): Textile design courses for patterns, sewing, embroidery, garment-making

## Illustration & Drawing Courses

- [Digital Illustration Courses - Create Art Digitally | 2025 | Domestika](https://www.domestika.org/en/courses/area/102-digital-illustration): Digital illustration courses using Procreate, Adobe, character design
- [Traditional Illustration Courses - Art Skills | 2025 | Domestika](https://www.domestika.org/en/courses/area/2-traditional-illustration): Traditional illustration courses covering watercolor, sketching, manga
- [Drawing Courses - Improve Your Art Skills | 2025 | Domestika](https://www.domestika.org/en/courses/area/92-drawing): Drawing courses covering sketching, portraits, watercolor techniques

## Arts, Crafts & Fine Arts Courses

- [Fine Arts Courses - Master Artistic Skills | 2025 | Domestika](https://www.domestika.org/en/courses/area/30-fine-arts): Fine arts courses covering painting, sculpture, figure drawing
- [Arts & Crafts Courses - Creative Projects | 2025 | Domestika](https://www.domestika.org/en/courses/area/21-arts-crafts): Arts and crafts courses for sewing, woodworking, handicrafts
- [DIY Courses - Create Handmade Projects | 2025 | Domestika](https://www.domestika.org/en/courses/area/164-diy): DIY courses for handmade projects, sewing, furniture, crafts
